target.name: Unone Core AI development surface
target.scope: Windows x64 public CLI and persistent developer protocol: create a synthetic starter; schema-led input, transient Enact edits, snapshots/watch, invalid request repair, stale revision/session boundaries, same-version recording/replay, and published headless memory/GC diagnostics. Excludes full static type-check completion, release packaging, graphical rendering, other platforms, all engine subsystems, MCP transport, optional npm SDK wrapper and commercial readiness.
target.revision: Executable sha256:6af56a589c4a39d3f16e176cfb2fc817ef7fcbbe7836e160c516973e86cc8c8e; checkout master 7bc124931e6a6ed47ee28b6dc3e7bc7646d37b5d with pre-existing dirty paths. Build-to-HEAD provenance not attested.
target.environment: Windows x64, Node v24.14.1, existing release game.exe. New synthetic C: OS temp projects only; no network, downloads, external accounts/providers, real games or service changes.

entryPoints: Existing target/release/game.exe --help / project init / session --schema / api search / platform snapshot
limitations: Aggregate of preserved initial 31-operation blind subtrial, 12-process-step informed memory/discovery probe (including one nested fingerprint CLI), and 30-operation reviewed session reproduction. Root's unrecorded orientation commands are not counted as trial steps or substituted for recorder evidence.

Initial subagent saw only public entries/task/boundaries, not rubric or expected scores; original first-use report was frozen before reproductions and informed semantic review. First success means project init, not help.
Only natural ordering error is capabilities query before project init. Unknown field, stale revision, old session and wrong fingerprint were deliberate negative cases, not natural wrong guesses.

Initial verify failed LUAU_ANALYZER_NOT_FOUND while assets and two tests passed. Full type checking, portable dependency repair, clean build and release pipeline are not verified; no analyzer was downloaded and the gate was not weakened.

The initial interactive transport was deliberately stopped after runtime close; its nonzero cleanup exit is not counted as a successful execution capture. The separate recorder session run closed by EOF and exited zero.

Public task completion used no product implementation. Root separately inspected the optional Node SDK source while orienting; that wrapper is outside this scope and was not used to finish CLI/protocol operations.

Exact existing executable identity is checked in probes because binary exceeds recorder 2 MiB subject-file limit. Hash descriptor plus actual before/after executable hashing is not a signed attestation to checkout HEAD.
Synthetic headless measurements are not rendered FPS, a load benchmark, proof of no leaks or a performance improvement. GPU, Rust allocator, JS GC and retaining paths remain unavailable.
No browser/native UI, macOS/iOS/Android, external plugin renderers, hostile-code OS sandbox, MCP transport, true cross-process continuation or real YesSir project verification.

evidence.quote: Unone is an AI-native **3D game engine prototype with 2D workflows**
One connection owns one headless runtime.
main Luau VM only; excludes worker VMs, Rust, JS, WASM allocator and GPU

issues.summary: 目的搜尋一次回大量完整 descriptor，第一個候選對 move entity 並不直接。
issues.cause: 實際 query 回 19 matches / 24132 bytes，firstMatch instances3d.remove；未讀匹配實作，所以 substring matching 僅為假設。
issues.fix: 以既有公開 descriptor 做 compact purpose candidates → selected contract，不複製維護第二套 runtime API。
issues.verification: 重跑同英文 query，記錄 actual bytes / 候選相關性；另用 fresh agent 看能否更早找到 setPosition，不能發明 token savings。

issues.summary: 中文 GC/記憶體目的在 Engine API search 找不到實際存在的診斷工具。
issues.cause: api search 的宣告範圍為 public_engine_api，不涵蓋 CLI/developer diagnostics；回應建議 complete API index / systems，沒有導到 memory/replay。
issues.fix: 讓目的發現層跨到既有公開 CLI/developer 能力；保持玩法 Luau 與 host diagnostics 邊界。
issues.verification: 用原 query 能發現並依 describe 跑成功現有 40-tick memory fixture；不新增重複 leak 工具。

issues.summary: 空目錄照 capabilities-first 起手，會先遇到 project config missing。
issues.cause: 首次 agent 第 2 操作 platform snapshot 在 init 之前，error PROJECT_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND；新建後相同入口成功。
issues.fix: 文件起點明示 new project 先 init、existing project 先 snapshot，而非隱藏缺 project 的错误。
issues.verification: 新 agent 從相同公開起點在空目錄不先猜不存在的配置；保留原初次紀錄。

issues.summary: 完整 verify 在 fresh temp 缺少 official luau-analyze。
issues.cause: 原始 types gate 給 LUAU_ANALYZER_NOT_FOUND；此任務不允許下載/build，未供應 analyzer 路徑。不是已診斷的 Rust runtime crash。
issues.fix: 在獨立 portable-SDK dependency 流程驗證工具發現／既有 analyzer override，保留具體缺檔錯誤；不 auto-download 或弱化 type gate。
issues.verification: 在有/無 analyzer 的乾淨 cwd 分別確認 success / actionable refusal；本次未標此項已修復。

issues.summary: 部分可修復錯誤仍主要靠 prose，structured facts/actions 不完整。
issues.cause: wrong field 和 exact-version refusal 透過 explanation 或 fingerprintDifferences 可得原因，但 diagnostics facts/suggested_actions 可空。
issues.fix: 在通用診斷契約補 field/path/actual/expected/action；不塞遊戲規則進 runtime。
issues.verification: 用保存的 framse 與 mismatched executable 原始負例確認結構化修復資料，然後重跑正例且原 capture 不被覆寫。
